name: YUGA desktop finish preview
body:
YUGA desktop preview: focus recovery, presentation refinements and an explicitly documented Linux runtime scheduling patch.

Source: 96d5b9cd3114b9732f7dc80433b1ca0a1d4a9b12.

DRAFT — exact successor package qualification is still in progress. No downloadable artifacts are attached yet. Two separate fresh-cache diagnostics passed against the previous immutable PCK; these do not substitute for executing the new archive. The previous unmodified-runtime package cold failure remains recorded.

The playable product is the original offline Rama slice with Bow training and Confluence practice. Native online matches, the full roster and the commercial graphics target remain open. Windows execution and physical-GPU performance have not been verified in this cloud.
